name: grain_maize

source.t_base_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.1: Tbase 8 degC.
source.t_upper_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.1: Tupper 30 degC.

source.stages: [D] emergence 95, stem_elongation 328, tassel 733, flowering 840, maturity 1515 are development units accumulated by the Python port of the model's thermal-time rule (clamped daily Tmin/Tmax, Tbase/Tupper above) along the Frankfurt/Main daily record (DWD station 01420), 1992-2024, from the year's mean sowing date to the year's mean date of the DWD phase (annual reporters of all German stations, quality level <= 3; DWD CDC opendata phenology/annual_reporters/crops), averaged over 32 seasons (DWD maize phases 12 Auflaufen BBCH 10, 67 Laengenwachstum BBCH 31, 65 Fahnenschieben BBCH 53, 5 Bluete Beginn BBCH 61, 24 Ernte; sd 13/31/41/37/67 units; mean doys sowing 116.6, emergence 131.4, BBCH 31 158.9, tassel 195.0, flowering 203.8, yellow ripe 255.0, harvest 268.2; the harvest mean mixes silage and grain maize, so the grain maize maturity is at the lower edge of the annex range emergence + 1450-1850). Senescence 1250 [AS]: the annex range emergence + 1150-1500 starts at 1245. Overripe 1800 [AS]: grain left to dry on the plant.

source.cc0_cm2_per_plant: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.2: soil surface covered by an individual seedling 6.50 cm2/plant.
source.plant_density_per_ha: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.2: 50 000 - 100 000 plants per hectare (management); 90 000 is German grain maize practice, inside the range.
source.ccx: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.2: maximum canopy cover 65-99 %; 0.95 inside the range.
source.cgc_per_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.2: canopy growth coefficient 0.012-0.013 per GDD.
source.cdc_per_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.2: canopy decline coefficient 0.010 per GDD.
source.senescence_acceleration: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: extra senescence progress per unit of senescence stress (1 - Ks_sen); the model's own device (AquaCrop shifts the senescence start instead).)

source.kc_tr_x: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 2: KcTr,x 1.05.
source.height_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 12 (fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm): field maize maximum crop height 2 m.
source.p_depletion: [C] FAO-56 Table 22 (fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0e.htm): field maize p = 0.55 at ETc ~ 5 mm/day, rooting depth 1.0-1.7 m.
source.p_adjust_for_etc: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: FAO-56 Table 22 note: p = p_table + 0.04 (5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8 (the limits are in the code as the note's own range).)
source.exp_p_upper: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.1: canopy expansion 0.14.
source.exp_p_lower: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.1: canopy expansion 0.72.
source.exp_shape: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.1: shape factor for canopy expansion 2.9.
source.sen_p_upper: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.1: canopy senescence psen 0.69.
source.sen_shape: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.1: shape factor for canopy senescence 2.7.

source.wp_star_g_m2: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 3.1: WP* 33.7 g/m2 (C4: the CO2 table of AquaCrop enters through f_type = (40 - 33.7)/20 = 0.315).
source.gdd_full: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.2: minimum growing degrees for full biomass production 12 degC day (estimated).
source.rue_g_mj: [M] 1.6 g/MJ of global radiation for maize. The recalled literature value is 1.9 (Kiniry et al. 1989: about 3.8 g/MJ PAR before grain filling, x 0.5 PAR share; not looked up), which gave +29 %% over the Destatis 2016/21 national grain maize mean (95.3 dt/ha at 14 %% moisture); 1.6 puts the 30-year mean on the home loess about 9 %% above it, the site being favourable like the wheat site (+5 %%).
source.rue_t_low_c: [AS] the C4 light-use efficiency starts at the base temperature 8 degC ...
source.light_primary: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: 1: the daily gain is the light potential x Tr/Tr_potential (the water factor of the AquaCrop gain, Tr = transpiration, Tr_potential = Kcb x ET0), WP* is then not used for the gain. 0: the smaller of the light potential and WP* x Tr/ET0. With 0 and the ramp below the harvest was 14 % under the DESTATIS mean at the same BBCH 31 biomass (F1d part 1); with 1 the same early biomass keeps the yield, bec)
source.co2_response: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), chapter 3, Table 3.11c/1 (Eq. 3.11c): multiplier of WP* for a C3 crop (f_type = 1) over the atmospheric CO2 concentration, the FACE-based column (fsink 0); WP* is normalised to 369.41 ppm (the year 2000). Applied to WP* and, as photosynthesis, to rue. The crop's f_type = clamp((40 - WP*)/20, 0, 1) (Eq. 3.11d).)

source.hi0: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 3.2: reference harvest index 48-52 %; 0.50.
source.hi_build_gdd: [D] development units from the flowering stage to maturity of the stage table (1515 - 840).
source.flowering_length_gdd: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 1.3: length of the flowering stage 150-200 GDD; 175.
source.excess_fruits_pct: [AS] the annex lists the excess of potential fruits as small without a number.
source.ppol: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.1: pollination fails above a depletion of 0.80 of TAW (estimate).
source.sto_coefficient_b: [AS] the annex lists the negative effect of stomatal closure on the harvest index as strong; b = 3 (1 = strongest, 20 = small).
source.cold_t_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.2: cold stress for pollination below 10 degC (estimate).
source.cold_width_k: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, section 3.12.5: cold pollination coefficient reaches 0 five degrees below the threshold.)
source.heat_t_c: [C] AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.2 Maize, section 4.2: heat stress for pollination above 40 degC (estimate).
source.heat_width_k: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3, chapter 3 (calculation procedures), section 3.12, section 3.12.5: heat pollination coefficient reaches 0 five degrees above the threshold (F1a had a 6 K width).)
source.logistic_steepness: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the manual says the temperature Ks curves are logistic (section 3.2.3) but prints no equation; this is the steepness of a logistic rescaled to hit 0 and 1 at the limits.)
source.straw_harvest_fraction: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: Koernermais straw (stover) ratio 1:1 with the grain; with the harvest index 0.50 all of the non-grain biomass is stover, capped at 0.95 (stubble stays).

source.zr_min_m: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: AquaCrop Reference Manual v7.3 (FAO, July 2026), Annex I.10 Wheat, section 1.4: minimum effective rooting depth 0.30 m.)
source.zr_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 22: field maize maximum rooting depth 1.0-1.7 m (middle); AquaCrop allows up to 2.80 m (management).
source.gdd_full: [AS] development units from sowing at which the maximum depth is reached (before flowering).

source.kill_onset_c: [AS] maize is frost-tender: leaves are damaged from about -2 degC.
source.kill_full_c: [AS] daily minimum at which the whole stand is killed.
source.snow_insulation_swe_mm: [AS] unused in practice (the crop is not in the field in snow).
source.snow_floor_c: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: lowest temperature the stand sees under that snow.)

source.harvest_window_days: [AS] days after maturity before the grain starts to shed: maize ears stay on the plant.
source.shed_rate_per_day: [AS] fraction of the remaining grain lost per day afterwards (ear drop, lodging).

source.nc_a: [C] Plenet and Lemaire 2000 (Plant and Soil 216:65-82) critical N curve Nc = 3.4 W^-0.37, W in t dry matter/ha, as quoted in Sci. Data 9:277 (2022), PMC9174182 (value from the quoting paper, not the original).
source.nc_w_min_t_ha: [AS] below 1 t/ha the curve is held at its value for 1 t/ha (the authors' own filter for the dataset).
source.nc_const_pct: [C] Nc at W = 1 t/ha of the curve above.
source.n_min_conc_pct: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: N concentration at which growth stops.)
source.n_stress_start_t_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: the N factor applies once the aboveground dry matter exceeds this.)
source.n_uptake_frac_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the available soil mineral N the roots can take per day.)
source.n_residual_kg_ha: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: soil mineral N the roots cannot take.)
source.n_root_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: root N as a fraction of the aboveground N.)
source.n_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: Koernermais grain 1.38 kg N/dt, stover 0.90 kg/dt, ratio 1:1.
source.n_fixation_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: cereals do not fix nitrogen.)
source.p2o5_conc_pct_dm: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: total aboveground P2O5 per t fresh grain over the aboveground dry matter 0.86/0.50 t.
source.p2o5_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: grain 0.80, stover 0.20 kg P2O5/dt.
source.k2o_conc_pct_dm: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: as p2o5_conc_pct_dm for K2O.
source.k2o_grain_share: [D] LfL Bayern Bas22 (Basisdaten Duengung und Naehrstofffluesse, 10.12.2021) Tab. 1a: grain 0.50, stover 2.00 kg K2O/dt.
source.ph_opt_low: [AS] pH (CaCl2) from which maize is unrestricted.
source.ph_opt_high: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )
source.ph_floor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: pH at which the factor is ph_floor_factor.)
source.ph_floor_factor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )
source.lodging_nmin_start_kg_ha: [AS] maize is much less prone to N-induced lodging than cereals.
source.lodging_bbch_from: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: window of the stem elongation to flowering stages in which surplus N makes the stand lodge.)
source.lodging_bbch_to: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: )

source.root_dm_fraction: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: root dry matter as a share of the aboveground dry matter at harvest; cereal root:shoot at maturity is about 0.1-0.2 (recalled).)
source.root_upper_share: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the root residue in the top 0.10 m of the 0.30 m management layers.)
source.seed_mass_g: [D] thousand-kernel weight 280 g of grain maize (250-350 g).
source.seed_viability: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: germination capacity of drilled seed (the German seed law minimum is 85 %, certified lots are above 92 %).)
source.depth_opt_min_m: [AS] maize is drilled 4-6 cm deep (extension advice, recalled).
source.depth_zero_m: [AS] emergence fails from about 12 cm for the large seed.
source.depth_surface_factor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence of seed lying on the surface (birds, drying) relative to the optimum depth.)
source.seedbed_floor: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence factor of the worst seedbed; field emergence of drilled wheat is typically 75-85 % of the seeds, which this reproduces together with seed_viability.)
source.residue_emergence_penalty: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: emergence lost at full residue cover for a tool with residue_tolerance 0.)
source.germ_wet_min: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: wetness at sowing depth (1 - De/TEW at the surface, blended to the root zone at the foot of the evaporation layer) below which the seed does not germinate.)
source.germ_wet_full: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: wetness from which germination runs at full rate.)
source.dry_hazard_per_day: [AS] value of winter_wheat.json reused for grain_maize, not crop-specific (wheat entry: share of the sown seed that dies per day in a seed layer below germ_wet_min.)
source.compensation_density_m2: [AS] maize barely tillers but one plant still takes up freed light and water: 6.2 plants/m2 give about 92 % and 3.7 plants/m2 about 75 % of the 9 plants/m2 reference (fits replant tables as recalled, not looked up); constant d0 of the yield-density law 1 - exp(-d/d0).

pathogen.agent: Fusarium ear and stalk rot and maize pests that overwinter in the residue

source.loss_max: [AS] not found as a published number for this crop; plausible order of the self-incompatibility yield penalty named in rotation guidance.
source.season_gdd: [D] development units (daily gdd, clamped Tmin/Tmax) from emergence to maturity along the same thermal rule as data/crops/grain_maize.json's stages, rounded; the build per day is proportional to the day's gdd over this number.
source.decay_half_life_days: [AS] see loss_max; rotation guidance recommends 3-4 years between host crops for the long-lived pathogens of beet and about one year for maize residue diseases.
source.suppression_max: [AS] no suppression modelled for this family (0).
source.suppression_gain: [AS] no suppression modelled for this family (0).
source.residue_ref_c_kg_ha: [AS] surface residue carbon at which the source is complete.

source: F1d grain maize (family maize). Annex I.2 Maize values of the AquaCrop reference manual v7.3 are [C]; the stage table is [D] from DWD phenology and the Frankfurt station (silage and grain maize reporters are not separated by DWD; the harvest date is their mean); nutrient removal is [D] from LfL Bayern Bas22 (Koernermais). Silage maize is not a separate file: its yield is the whole aboveground biomass at the same stage.
